message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No confirmed direct vulnerability match was found for the components in `DLL_software_component.txt` during the 24-hour window from 2026-09-28 07:40 UTC to 2026-09-29 07:40 UTC (2026-09-28 13:10 IST to 2026-09-29 13:10 IST). Two high-severity Angular SSR advisories were newly cataloged or updated in the window and are possible matches that need deployment verification.

### Possible matches needing review

**Finding 1**

- Affected product or component: `@angular/platform-server` in the listed ProcessDesigner Angular 8.2.14 and AppWizard Angular 12.2.0 applications, if server-side rendering is present
- Vulnerability: CVE-2026-101895 / GHSA-f67j-2jqw-jpq7
- Severity: High, CVSS 8.7
- Description: A malformed, incomplete DOCTYPE supplied to Angular's server-side DOM parser can trigger an infinite loop, consume a Node.js process at 100% CPU, and cause denial of service.
- Relevance: The advisory affects `@angular/platform-server` versions through 19.2.25, so the listed Angular versions fall within the affected version range. The inventory describes these applications as SPAs and does not confirm that the SSR package or vulnerable server-side input path is deployed.
- Source: [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-f67j-2jqw-jpq7) (added to the database and reviewed September 28, 2026)

**Finding 2**

- Affected product or component: `@angular/platform-server` in the listed ProcessDesigner Angular 8.2.14 and AppWizard Angular 12.2.0 applications, if server-side rendering is present
- Vulnerability: CVE-2026-88058 / GHSA-j3r3-mxqp-r2p4
- Severity: High, CVSS 8.6
- Description: Angular SSR can serialize attacker-controlled processing-instruction data inside certain fallback raw-content elements without escaping a matching closing tag, allowing cross-site scripting in affected rendering flows.
- Relevance: The advisory affects `@angular/platform-server` versions through 19.2.25, which includes the listed Angular versions, but exploitation requires SSR plus programmatic creation of a processing-instruction node with untrusted data inside a fallback raw-content element. The DLL list does not establish those conditions.
- Source: [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j3r3-mxqp-r2p4) (added to the database and reviewed September 28, 2026)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries and services.

No qualifying new MongoDB-family vulnerability was confirmed in the scan window. The latest authoritative MongoDB security notices found were dated September 8, outside this run's 24-hour window.

Source checked: [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts).

### Review priority

Promptly verify whether either listed Angular application includes `@angular/platform-server` or otherwise performs Angular SSR. If neither does, the two advisory matches are not applicable. No other component in the assigned DLL inventory requires immediate review based on a newly reported in-window vulnerability.
